blockingFindings.title: Revision conflict regression no longer exercises post-mutation rollback
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 case labeled "registry revision conflict" injects `ACTIVE_FLOW_REGISTRY_REVISION_CONFLICT` by making `ActiveFlowRegistry.prototype.snapshot` throw on its first call. That fails during `AcceptanceDecisionRegistrySnapshot.capture()` before `applyAcceptanceDecision()` writes the decision artifact or mutates flow state, so it does not verify the required rollback path where registry verification fails after the decision mutation has already happened.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Restore a revision-conflict helper that returns the initial snapshot normally, then changes the second snapshot revision during `AcceptanceDecisionRegistrySnapshot.verify()`, and assert the snapshot call count reaches that post-mutation boundary.
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 is mapped to the acceptance-decision registry test and requires binding/registry failures to leave flow state and pointers unchanged. A pre-capture failure cannot prove unchanged state after a partial decision mutation, so this mandatory acceptance requirement is not covered.
